macros.name: addabbrvspace
macros.doc: Adds a space penalized by the value of the abbrvpenalty counter, see §§ 3.12.4 and 4.10.3 for details.

macros.name: addabthinspace
macros.doc: Similar to \addabbrvspace but using a thin space.

macros.name: addbibresource
macros.doc: Adds a ⟨resource⟩, such as a .bib file, to the default resource list.

macros.name: addcolon
macros.doc: Adds a colon unless it is preceded by a comma, a semicolon, another colon, or a period.

macros.name: addcomma
macros.doc: Adds a comma unless it is preceded by another comma, a semicolon, a colon, or a period.

macros.name: adddot
macros.doc: Adds a period unless it is preceded by any punctuation mark.

macros.name: adddotspace
macros.doc: Executes \adddot and adds a space penalized by the value of the abbrvpenalty counter, see §§ 3.12.4 and 4.10.3 for details.

macros.name: addexclam
macros.doc: Adds an exclamation mark unless it is preceded by any punctuation mark except for an abbreviation dot.

macros.name: addglobalbib
macros.doc: This command differs from \addbibresource in that the ⟨resource⟩ is added to the global resource list.

macros.name: addhighpenspace
macros.doc: Adds a space penalized by the value of the highnamepenalty counter, see §§ 3.12.4 and 4.10.3 for details.

macros.name: addhpthinspace
macros.doc: Similar to \addhighpenspace but adds a breakable thin space.

macros.name: addlowpenspace
macros.doc: Adds a space penalized by the value of the lownamepenalty counter, see §§ 3.12.4 and 4.10.3 for details.

macros.name: addlpthinspace
macros.doc: Similar to \addlowpenspace but adds a breakable thin space.

macros.name: addnbspace
macros.doc: Adds a non-breakable interword space.

macros.name: addnbthinspace
macros.doc: Adds a non-breakable thin space.

macros.name: addperiod
macros.doc: Adds a period unless it is preceded by an abbreviation dot or any other punctuation mark.

macros.name: addquestion
macros.doc: Adds a question mark unless it is preceded by any punctuation mark except for an abbreviation dot.

macros.name: addsectionbib
macros.doc: This command differs from \addbibresource in that the resource ⟨options⟩ are registered but the ⟨resource⟩ not added to any resource list.

macros.name: addsemicolon
macros.doc: Adds a semicolon unless it is preceded by a comma, another semicolon, a colon, or a period.

macros.name: addslash
macros.doc: Adds a breakable slash.

macros.name: addspace
macros.doc: Adds a breakable interword space.

macros.name: addthinspace
macros.doc: Adds a breakable thin space.

macros.name: addtocategory
macros.doc: Assigns a ⟨key⟩ to a ⟨category⟩, to be used in conjunction with the category and notcategory filters of \printbibliography.

macros.name: andmoredelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed before the localisation string ‘andmore’ if a literal list like publisher or location is truncated.

macros.name: andothersdelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed before the localisation string ‘andothers’ if a name list like author or editor is truncated.

macros.name: AtBeginBibliography
macros.doc: Appends the ⟨code⟩ to an internal hook executed at the beginning of the bibliography.

macros.name: AtBeginBiblist
macros.doc: Appends the ⟨code⟩ to an internal hook executed at the beginning of the bibliography list ⟨biblistname⟩.

macros.name: AtBeginRefsection
macros.doc: Appends the ⟨code⟩ to an internal hook executed at the beginning of every reference section.

macros.name: AtBeginShorthands
macros.doc: Appends the ⟨code⟩ to an internal hook executed at the beginning of the list of shorthands.

macros.name: AtEachCitekey
macros.doc: Similar to \AtEveryCitekey but only affecting the current citation command.

macros.name: AtEveryBibitem
macros.doc: Appends the ⟨code⟩ to an internal hook executed at the beginning of every item in the bibliography.

macros.name: AtEveryBiblistitem
macros.doc: Appends the ⟨code⟩ to an internal hook executed at the beginning of every item in the bibliography list named ⟨biblistname⟩.

macros.name: AtEveryCite
macros.doc: Appends the ⟨code⟩ to an internal hook executed at the beginning of every citation command.

macros.name: AtEveryCitekey
macros.doc: Appends the ⟨code⟩ to an internal hook executed once for every entry key passed to a citation command.

macros.name: AtEveryEntrykey
macros.doc: Appends ⟨code⟩ to an internal hook executed every time an entrykey is processed for a citation command or \nocite.

macros.name: AtEveryLositem
macros.doc: Appends the ⟨code⟩ to an internal hook executed at the beginning of every item in the list of shorthands.

macros.name: AtEveryMultiCite
macros.doc: Appends the ⟨code⟩ to an internal hook executed at the beginning of every multicite command.

macros.name: AtNextBibliography
macros.doc: Similar to \AtBeginBibliography but only affecting the next \printbibliography.

macros.name: AtNextCite
macros.doc: Similar to \AtEveryCite but only affecting the next citation command.

macros.name: AtNextCitekey
macros.doc: Similar to \AtEveryCitekey but only affecting the next entry key.

macros.name: AtNextMultiCite
macros.doc: Similar to \AtEveryMultiCite but only affecting the next multicite command.

macros.name: AtNextRefsection
macros.doc: Appends the ⟨code⟩ to an internal hook executed at the beginning of the next reference section.

macros.name: AtUsedriver
macros.doc: Appends the ⟨code⟩ to an internal hook executed when initializing \usedriver.

macros.name: AtVolcite
macros.doc: Appends the ⟨code⟩ to an internal hook executed when initializing \volcite.

macros.name: authortypedelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed between the author and the authortype.

macros.name: autocap
macros.doc: Automatically converts the ⟨character⟩ to its uppercase form if biblatex’s punctuation tracker would capitalize a localisation string at the current location.

macros.name: autocite
macros.doc: In contrast to other citation commands, the \autocite command does not only scan ahead for punctuation marks following its last argument to avoid double punctuation marks, it actually moves them around if required.

macros.name: Autocite
macros.doc: \Autocite is similar to \autocite but capitalizes the name prefix of the first name in the citation if the useprefix option is enabled, provided that there is a name prefix and the citation style prints any name at all.

macros.name: Autocites
macros.doc: \Autocites is similar to \autocites but capitalizes the name prefix of the first name in the citation if the useprefix option is enabled, provided that there is a name prefix and the citation style prints any name at all.

macros.name: begrelateddelim
macros.doc: The generic separator before the block of related entries.

macros.name: bibbycategory
macros.doc: This command loops over all bibliography categories.

macros.name: bibbysection
macros.doc: This command automatically loops over all reference sections.

macros.name: bibbysegment
macros.doc: This command automatically loops over all reference segments.

macros.name: bibcplstring
macros.doc: Similar to \biblstring but the term is always capitalized.

macros.name: bibcpsstring
macros.doc: Similar to \bibsstring but the term is always capitalized.

macros.name: bibdateeraendprefix
macros.doc: The language specific marker which is printed as a prefix to end BCE/BC dates in a date range when the option dateera is set to ‘astronomical’.

macros.name: bibdateeraprefix
macros.doc: The language specific marker which is printed as a prefix to beginning BCE/BC dates in a date range when the option dateera is set to ‘astronomical’.

macros.name: bibdaterangesep
macros.doc: The language specific separator to be used for date ranges.

macros.name: bibdatesep
macros.doc: The language specific separator used between date components in terse date formats.

macros.name: bibdatetimesep
macros.doc: The language specific separator printed between date and time components when printing time components along with date components (see the <datetype>dateusetime option in § 3.1.2.1).

macros.name: bibdateuncertain
macros.doc: The language specific marker to be used after uncertain dates when the global option dateuncertain is enabled.

macros.name: bibeidpunct
macros.doc: The separator printed before the eid field (similar to \bibpagespunct).

macros.name: bibfont
macros.doc: Arbitrary code setting the font used in the bibliography.

macros.name: bibfootnotewrapper
macros.doc: An inner wrapper which encloses the ⟨text⟩ argument of \mkbibfootnote and \mkbibfootnotetext.

macros.name: bibhang
macros.doc: The hanging indentation of the bibliography, if applicable.

macros.name: bibhyperlink
macros.doc: A wrapper for hyperref’s \hyperlink command.

macros.name: bibhyperref
macros.doc: Transforms ⟨text⟩ into an internal link pointing to ⟨entrykey⟩ in the bibliography.

macros.name: bibhypertarget
macros.doc: A wrapper for hyperref’s \hypertarget command.

macros.name: bibindexinitdelim
macros.doc: Replaces \bibinitdelim in the index.

macros.name: bibindexinithyphendelim
macros.doc: Replaces \bibinithyphendelim in the index.

macros.name: bibindexinitperiod
macros.doc: Replaces \bibinitperiod in the index.

macros.name: bibindexnamedelima
macros.doc: Replaces \bibnamedelima in the index.

macros.name: bibindexnamedelimb
macros.doc: Replaces \bibnamedelimb in the index.

macros.name: bibindexnamedelimc
macros.doc: Replaces \bibnamedelimc in the index.

macros.name: bibindexnamedelimd
macros.doc: Replaces \bibnamedelimd in the index.

macros.name: bibindexnamedelimi
macros.doc: Replaces \bibnamedelimi in the index.

macros.name: bibinitdelim
macros.doc: The spacing inserted automatically by the backend between multiple initials unless \bibinithyphendelim applies.

macros.name: bibinithyphendelim
macros.doc: The punctuation inserted automatically by the backend between the initials of hyphenated name parts, replacing \bibinitperiod and \bibinitdelim.

macros.name: bibinitsep
macros.doc: Vertical space to be inserted between two entries in the bibliography whenever an entry starts with a letter which is different from the initial letter of the previous entry.

macros.name: bibitemsep
macros.doc: The vertical space between the individual entries in the bibliography.

macros.name: biblabelsep
macros.doc: The horizontal space between entries and their corresponding labels in the bibliography.

macros.name: biblclstring
macros.doc: Similar to \biblstring but the whole term is lowercased.

macros.name: biblcsstring
macros.doc: Similar to \bibsstring but the whole term is lowercased.

macros.name: biblcstring
macros.doc: Similar to \bibstring but the whole term is lowercased.

macros.name: BibliographyWarning
macros.doc: This command is similar to \PackageWarning but prints the entry key of the entry currently being processed in addition to the input line number.

macros.name: biblstring
macros.doc: Similar to \bibstring but always prints the long string, ignoring the abbreviate option.

macros.name: bibname
macros.doc: The term ‘bibliography’, also available as \bibname.

macros.name: bibnamedash
macros.doc: The dash to be used as a replacement for recurrent authors or editors in the bibliography.

macros.name: bibnamedelima
macros.doc: This delimiter controls the spacing between the elements which make up a name part.

macros.name: bibnamedelimc
macros.doc: This delimiter controls the spacing between name parts.

macros.name: bibnamedelimd
macros.doc: This delimiter controls the spacing between name parts.

macros.name: bibnamedelimi
macros.doc: This delimiter replaces \bibnamedelima/b after initials.

macros.name: bibnamesep
macros.doc: Vertical space to be inserted between two entries in the bibliography whenever an entry starts with a name which is different from the initial name of the previous entry.

macros.name: bibncplstring
macros.doc: Similar to \biblstring but the term is never capitalized.

macros.name: bibncpsstring
macros.doc: Similar to \bibsstring but the term is never capitalized.

macros.name: bibncpstring
macros.doc: Similar to \bibstring but the term is never capitalized.

macros.name: bibpagerefpunct
macros.doc: The separator printed before the pageref field.

macros.name: bibpagespunct
macros.doc: The separator printed before the pages field.

macros.name: bibparsep
macros.doc: The vertical space between paragraphs within an entry in the bibliography.

macros.name: bibrangedash
macros.doc: The language specific dash to be used for ranges of numbers.

macros.name: bibrangessep
macros.doc: The language specific separator to be used between multiple ranges.

macros.name: bibsetup
macros.doc: Arbitrary code to be executed at the beginning of the bibliography, intended for commands which affect the layout of the bibliography.

macros.name: bibsstring
macros.doc: Similar to \bibstring but always prints the short string, ignoring the abbreviate option.

macros.name: bibstring
macros.doc: Prints the localisation string ⟨key⟩, where ⟨key⟩ is an identifier in lowercase letters (see § 4.9.2).

macros.name: bibtimesep
macros.doc: The language specific marker which separates time components.

macros.name: bibtimezonesep
macros.doc: The language specific marker which separates an optional time zone component from a time.

macros.name: bibtzminsep
macros.doc: The language specific marker which separates hour and minute component of offset timezones.

macros.name: bibuclstring
macros.doc: Similar to \biblstring but the whole term is uppercased.

macros.name: bibucsstring
macros.doc: Similar to \bibsstring but the whole term is uppercased.

macros.name: bibucstring
macros.doc: Similar to \bibstring but the whole term is uppercased.

macros.name: biburlbigskip
macros.doc: The biblatex version of \Urlmuskip. This length holds the additional (stretchable) space inserted around breakable characters in the \url command from the url package.

macros.name: biburlnumskip
macros.doc: The additional space inserted after numbers in strings formatted with the \url command from the url package.

macros.name: biburlucskip
macros.doc: Similar to biburlnumskip, except that it will add space after all uppercase letters.

macros.name: bibutctimezone
macros.doc: The language specific string printed for the UTC timezone.

macros.name: brackettext
macros.doc: This command wraps the ⟨text⟩ in context sensitive brackets.

macros.name: citedate
macros.doc: This command prints the full date (date or year).

macros.name: citereset
macros.doc: This command resets the citation style.

macros.name: citesetup
macros.doc: Arbitrary code to be executed at the beginning of each citation command.

macros.name: citetitle
macros.doc: This command prints the title.

macros.name: citeurl
macros.doc: This command prints the url field.

macros.name: citeyear
macros.doc: This command prints the year (year field or year component of date).

macros.name: clearfield
macros.doc: Clears the ⟨field⟩ (optionally a multiscript field of ⟨msform⟩/⟨mslang⟩ of which both or neither optional arguments must be provided) within a local scope.

macros.name: compcitedelim
macros.doc: Similar to \multicitedelim, but used by certain citation styles when ‘compressing’ multiple citations.

macros.name: currentfield
macros.doc: The name of the field currently being processed by \printfield.

macros.name: currentlang
macros.doc: The name of the currently active language for biblatex.

macros.name: currentlist
macros.doc: The name of the literal list currently being processed by \printlist.

macros.name: currentname
macros.doc: The name of the name list currently being processed by \printnames.

macros.name: datecircadelim
macros.doc: When formatting dates with the global option datecirca enabled, the delimiter printed after any localised ‘circa’ term.

macros.name: datecircaprint
macros.doc: Prints date circa information when the global option datecirca is enabled and the \ifdatecirca test is true.

macros.name: datecircaprintiso
macros.doc: Prints iso8601-2 format date circa information when the global option datecirca is enabled and the \ifdatecirca test is true.

macros.name: dateeradelim
macros.doc: When formatting dates with the global option dateera set, the delimiter printed before the localisation era term.

macros.name: dateeraprint
macros.doc: Prints date era information when the global option dateera is set to ‘secular’ or ‘christian’.

macros.name: dateeraprintpre
macros.doc: Prints date era information when the global option dateera is set to ‘astronomical’.

macros.name: dateuncertainprint
macros.doc: Prints date uncertainty information when the global option dateuncertain is enabled and the \ifdateuncertain test is true.

macros.name: DeclareAutoPunctuation
macros.doc: This command defines the punctuation marks to be considered by the citation commands as they scan ahead for punctuation.

macros.name: DeclareBiblatexOption
macros.doc: This command is a convenient interface to declare an option for several scopes at once.

macros.name: DeclareBibliographyAlias
macros.doc: If a bibliography driver covers more than one entry type, this command may be used to define an alias where ⟨entrytype⟩ is the name of a defined driver.

macros.name: DeclareBibliographyCategory
macros.doc: Declares a new ⟨category⟩, to be used in conjunction with \addtocategory and the category and notcategory filters of \printbibliography.

macros.name: DeclareBibliographyDriver
macros.doc: Defines a bibliography driver.

macros.name: DeclareBibliographyOption
macros.doc: This command defines additional preamble options in ⟨key⟩=⟨value⟩ format.

macros.name: DeclareBiblistFilter
macros.doc: Defines a bibliography list filter with ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: DeclareBibstringSetFormat
macros.doc: Defines the bibliography string format for ⟨setname⟩.

macros.name: DeclareCapitalPunctuation
macros.doc: This command defines the punctuation marks which will cause localisation strings to be capitalized if one of them precedes a string.

macros.name: DeclareCiteCommand
macros.doc: This is the core command used to define all citation commands.

macros.name: DeclareCitePunctuationPosition
macros.doc: Set up the cite command ⟨command⟩ to move punctuation marks after the citation like \autocite.

macros.name: DeclareDataInheritance
macros.doc: \DeclareDataInheritance sets the inheritance ⟨options⟩ for a specific ⟨source⟩ and ⟨target⟩ combination.

macros.name: DeclareDelimAlias
macros.doc: Declares ⟨alias⟩ to be an alias for the delimiter ⟨delim⟩.

macros.name: DeclareDelimFormat
macros.doc: Declares the delimiter macro ⟨name⟩ with the replacement text ⟨code⟩.

macros.name: DeclareEntryOption
macros.doc: Similar to \DeclareBibliographyOption but defines options which are settable on a per-entry basis in the options field from § 2.2.3.

macros.name: DeclareExtradate
macros.doc: Defines which date information used to construct the extradate field.

macros.name: DeclareExtradateContext
macros.doc: Defines the context in which identical dates (as determined by \DeclareExtradate) are tracked so that extradate can be appended for disambiguation purposes.

macros.name: DeclareFieldAlias
macros.doc: Declares ⟨alias⟩ to be an alias for the field format ⟨format⟩.

macros.name: DeclareFieldFormat
macros.doc: Defines the field format ⟨format⟩.

macros.name: DeclareFieldInputHandler
macros.doc: This command can be used to define a data input handler for ⟨field⟩ when it is read from the .bbl.

macros.name: DeclareIndexFieldAlias
macros.doc: Declares ⟨alias⟩ to be an alias for the field format ⟨format⟩.

macros.name: DeclareIndexListAlias
macros.doc: Declares ⟨alias⟩ to be an alias for the literal list format ⟨format⟩.

macros.name: DeclareIndexListFormat
macros.doc: Defines the literal list format ⟨format⟩.

macros.name: DeclareIndexNameAlias
macros.doc: Declares ⟨alias⟩ to be an alias for the name list format ⟨format⟩.

macros.name: DeclareIndexNameFormat
macros.doc: Defines the name list format ⟨format⟩.

macros.name: DeclareLabelalphaNameTemplate
macros.doc: Defines the labelalphaname template ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: DeclareLabelalphaTemplate
macros.doc: Defines the alphabetic label template for the given entrytypes.

macros.name: DeclareLabeldate
macros.doc: Defines the date components to consider when generating labelyear, labelmonth, labelday, labelendyear, labelendmonth and labelendday fields (see § 4.2.4.2).

macros.name: DeclareLabelname
macros.doc: Defines the fields to consider when generating the labelname field (see § 4.2.4.2).

macros.name: DeclareLabeltitle
macros.doc: Defines the fields to consider when generating the labeltitle field (see § 4.2.4.2).

macros.name: DeclareLanguageMapping
macros.doc: This command maps a babel/polyglossia language identifier to an lbx file.

macros.name: DeclareLanguageMappingSuffix
macros.doc: This command defines a language file suffix which will be added when looking for .lbx language string definition files.

macros.name: DeclareListAlias
macros.doc: Declares ⟨alias⟩ to be an alias for the literal list format ⟨format⟩.

macros.name: DeclareListFormat
macros.doc: Defines the literal list format ⟨format⟩.

macros.name: DeclareListWrapperAlias
macros.doc: Declares ⟨alias⟩ to be an alias for the outer list format ⟨format⟩.

macros.name: DeclareListWrapperFormat
macros.doc: Defines the list wrapper format ⟨format⟩.

macros.name: DeclareMsselect
macros.doc: Defines the multiscript alternates to look for, in order, when attempting to print a multiscript field in the context of the language with ⟨langid⟩. ⟨langid⟩ can be a babel/polyglossia language specifier or BCP47 language tag.

macros.name: DeclareMultiCiteCommand
macros.doc: This command defines ‘multicite’ commands (§ 3.9.3).

macros.name: DeclareNameAlias
macros.doc: Declares ⟨alias⟩ to be an alias for the name list format ⟨format⟩.

macros.name: DeclareNameFormat
macros.doc: Defines the name list format ⟨format⟩.

macros.name: DeclareNameWrapperAlias
macros.doc: Declares ⟨alias⟩ to be an alias for the outer name list format ⟨format⟩.

macros.name: DeclareNameWrapperFormat
macros.doc: Defines the name list wrapper format ⟨format⟩.

macros.name: DeclareNoinit
macros.doc: Defines regular expressions to strip from names before generating initials.

macros.name: DeclareNolabel
macros.doc: Defines regular expressions to strip from any field before generating a label part for the field.

macros.name: DeclareNolabelwidthcount
macros.doc: Defines regular expressions to ignore from any field when counting characters in fixed-width substrings.

macros.name: DeclareNonamestring
macros.doc: Defines regular expressions to strip from name fields when generating fullhash and uniquename.

macros.name: DeclareNosort
macros.doc: Defines regular expressions to strip from particular fields or types of fields when sorting.

macros.name: DeclareNumChars
macros.doc: This command configures the \ifnumeral, \ifnumerals, and \ifpages tests from § 4.6.2.

macros.name: DeclarePrefChars
macros.doc: This command declares characters that are to be treated specially when testing to see if \bibnamedelimc is to be inserted between a name prefix and a family name.

macros.name: DeclarePresort
macros.doc: Specifies a string to be used to automatically populate the presort field of entries without a presort field.

macros.name: DeclarePrintbibliographyDefaults
macros.doc: This command can be used to globally set defaults for some options to \printbibliography, the \bibby... bibliography commands and \printbibheading.

macros.name: DeclarePunctuationPairs
macros.doc: Use this command to declare valid pairs of punctuation marks.

macros.name: DeclareQuotePunctuation
macros.doc: This command controls ‘American-style’ punctuation.

macros.name: DeclareRangeCommands
macros.doc: This command is similar to \DeclareRangeChars, except that the ⟨commands⟩ argument is an undelimited list of commands which are to be considered as range indicators.

macros.name: DeclareRedundantLanguages
macros.doc: This command provides the language mappings required by the clearlang option from § 3.1.2.1.

macros.name: DeclareRefcontext
macros.doc: Declares a named reference context with name ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: DeclareSortExclusion
macros.doc: Specifies fields to be excluded from sorting on a per-type basis.

macros.name: DeclareSortInclusion
macros.doc: Specifies fields to be included in sorting on a per-type basis.

macros.name: DeclareSortingNamekeyTemplate
macros.doc: Defines how the sorting keys for names are constructed.

macros.name: DeclareSortingTemplate
macros.doc: Defines the sorting template ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: DeclareSortTranslit
macros.doc: \DeclareSortTranslit declares which parts of an entry you would like to transliterate for sorting purposes.

macros.name: DeclareTypeOption
macros.doc: Similar to \DeclareBibliographyOption but defines options which are settable on a per-type basis using the optional argument of \ExecuteBibliographyOptions (see § 3.2.2).

macros.name: DeclareUniquenameTemplate
macros.doc: Defines the uniquename template ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: DefaultInheritance
macros.doc: Configures the default inheritance behavior.

macros.name: defbibcheck
macros.doc: Defines the custom bibliography filter ⟨name⟩, to be used via the check option of \printbibliography.

macros.name: defbibenvironment
macros.doc: This command defines bibliography environments.

macros.name: defbibfilter
macros.doc: Defines the custom bibliography filter ⟨name⟩, to be used via the filter option of \printbibliography.

macros.name: defbibheading
macros.doc: This command defines bibliography headings.

macros.name: defbibnote
macros.doc: Defines the bibliography note ⟨name⟩, to be used via the prenote and postnote options of \printbibliography and \printbiblist.

macros.name: DefineBibliographyExtras
macros.doc: This command is used to adapt language specific features such as the date format and ordinals.

macros.name: DefineBibliographyStrings
macros.doc: This command is used to define localisation strings.

macros.name: DefineHyphenationExceptions
macros.doc: This is a LaTeX frontend to TeX’s \hyphenation command which defines hyphenation exceptions.

macros.name: delimcontext
macros.doc: Set the delimiter context to ⟨context⟩.

macros.name: docsvfield
macros.doc: Similar to the \docsvlist command from the etoolbox package, except that it takes a field name as its argument (optionally a multiscript field of ⟨msform⟩/⟨mslang⟩).

macros.name: editortypedelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed between the editor and the editor or editortype string.

macros.name: enddatecircaprint
macros.doc: Prints date circa information when the global option datecirca is enabled and the \ifenddatecirca test is true.

macros.name: enddatecircaprintiso
macros.doc: Prints iso8601-2 format date circa information when the global option datecirca is enabled and the \ifenddatecirca test is true.

macros.name: enddateuncertainprint
macros.doc: Prints date uncertainty information when the global option dateuncertain is enabled and the \ifenddateuncertain test is true.

macros.name: entrydata
macros.doc: You may use \entrydata to switch contexts locally.

macros.name: entrysetpunct
macros.doc: The punctuation printed between bibliography subentries of an entry set.

macros.name: except
macros.doc: Defines an exception to the default inheritance rules.

macros.name: extpostnotedelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed between the citation and the parenthetical ⟨postnote⟩ argument of a citation command when the postnote occurs outside of the citation parentheses.

macros.name: filteror
macros.doc: A wrapper around one or more \filter commands specifying that they form a disjunctive set, i.e. any one of the ⟨filters⟩ must be satisfied.

macros.name: finalandcomma
macros.doc: Prints the comma to be inserted before the final ‘and’ in a list, if applicable in the respective language.

macros.name: finalandsemicolon
macros.doc: Prints the semicolon to be inserted before the final ‘and’ in a list of lists, if applicable in the respective language.

macros.name: finallistdelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed instead of \multilistdelim before the final item in a literal list.

macros.name: finalnamedelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed instead of \multinamedelim before the final name in a name list.

macros.name: finentrypunct
macros.doc: The punctuation printed at the very end of every bibliography entry, usually a period.

macros.name: fnotecite
macros.doc: Similar to \notecite but the notes are printed in a footnote.

macros.name: footfullcite
macros.doc: Similar to \fullcite but puts the entire citation in a footnote and adds a period at the end.

macros.name: forceE
macros.doc: Use this command in bib files if biblatex gets the ‘and’ before a certain name wrong. As its name suggests, it will enforce ‘e’.

macros.name: forceY
macros.doc: Similar to \forceE but enforces ‘y’.

macros.name: forcezerosmdt
macros.doc: This command adds zeros to a month, day or time part (or any number supposed to be 2-digits).

macros.name: forcezerosy
macros.doc: This command adds zeros to a year (or any number supposed to be 4-digits).

macros.name: forcsvfield
macros.doc: Similar to the \forcsvlist command from the etoolbox package, except that it takes a field name as its argument (optionally a multiscript field of ⟨msform⟩/⟨mslang⟩).

macros.name: fullcite
macros.doc: This command uses the bibliography driver for the respective entry type to create a full citation similar to the bibliography entry.

macros.name: GenRefcontextData
macros.doc: This command takes the same key/value options as \DeclareRefcontext. It forces the currently active refcontext, optionally modified by the key/value options, to be written to the .bcf so that biber will create a sorted data list for the specified refcontext.

macros.name: getcomputableequivalent
macros.doc: Saves the us-ascii representation of the number given as ⟨string⟩ in ⟨macro⟩.

macros.name: getdateannotation
macros.doc: Retrieve a literal annotation for the datefield ⟨datetype⟩.

macros.name: getfieldannotation
macros.doc: Retrieves any literal annotation for the field ⟨entryfield⟩ (optionally a multiscript field of ⟨msform⟩/⟨mslang⟩).

macros.name: getitemannotation
macros.doc: Retrieves any literal annotation for the item ⟨item⟩ in the field ⟨entryfield⟩ (optionally a multiscript field of ⟨msform⟩/⟨mslang⟩).

macros.name: getpartannotation
macros.doc: Retrieves any literal annotation for the part ⟨part⟩ of the item number ⟨item⟩ in the field ⟨entryfield⟩ (optionally a multiscript field of ⟨msform⟩/⟨mslang⟩).

macros.name: hascomputableequivalent
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨string⟩ can be transformed into a LaTeX-computable integer consisting only of us-ascii characters via \getcomputableequivalent and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: hasdateannotation
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the date field ⟨datetype⟩ has any annotation ⟨annotationname⟩ defined and false otherwise.

macros.name: hasfieldannotation
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the data field ⟨entryfield⟩ (optionally a multiscript field of ⟨msform⟩/⟨mslang⟩) has a literal annotation ⟨annotationname⟩ defined and false otherwise.

macros.name: hyphen
macros.doc: An explicit, breakable hyphen intended for compound words.

macros.name: ifandothers
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨list⟩ is defined and has been truncated in the bib file with the keyword ‘and others’, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifbibindex
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ or ⟨false⟩ depending on the indexing option from § 3.1.2.1.

macros.name: ifbibliography
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ when located in a bibliography, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifbibmacroundef
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the bibliography macro ⟨name⟩ is undefined, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifbibstring
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨string⟩ is a known localisation key, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifcapital
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if biblatex’s punctuation tracker would capitalize a localisation string at the current location, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifcategory
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the entry currently being processed has been assigned to a ⟨category⟩ with \addtocategory, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifcitation
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ when located in a citation, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifciteibid
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the entry currently being processed is the same as the last one, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifciteidem
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the primary name (i. e., the author or editor) in the entry currently being processed is the same as the last one, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifciteindex
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ or ⟨false⟩ depending on the indexing option from § 3.1.2.1.

macros.name: ifciteseen
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the entry currently being processed has been cited before, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifcrossrefsource
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the entry was inclued in the .bbl due to being referenced more than mincrossrefs times and false otherwise.

macros.name: ifcurrentfield
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the current field is ⟨field⟩, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifdateannotation
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the date field ⟨datetype⟩ has an annotation ⟨annotation⟩ and false otherwise.

macros.name: ifdaterangesequal
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the two date ranges—that is the start and the end date—hdatetype1i and hdatetype2i are the same.

macros.name: ifdriver
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if a driver for the ⟨entrytype⟩ is available, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifentryfieldundef
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨entryfield⟩ is undefined, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise. ⟨entryfield⟩ is the name of any entry field, regardless of type (field, list, name etc.).

macros.name: ifentryinbib
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the entry ⟨entrykey⟩ appears in the current bibliography, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifentrytype
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the entry type of the entry currently being processed is ⟨type⟩, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: iffieldequals
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the value of the ⟨field⟩ (optionally a multiscript field of ⟨msform⟩/⟨mslang⟩) is equal to the definition of ⟨macro⟩, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: iffieldequalstr
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the value of the ⟨field⟩ (optionally a multiscript field of ⟨msform⟩/⟨mslang⟩) is equal to ⟨string⟩, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: iffieldundef
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨field⟩ is undefined, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: iffirstcitekey
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the entry currently being processed is the first one in the citation list, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: iffootnote
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ when located in a footnote, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifhyperref
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the hyperref package option is enabled (which implies that the hyperref package has been loaded), and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifinteger
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨string⟩ is a positive integer, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifiscomputable
macros.doc: Returns ⟨true⟩ if \ifinteger or \hascomputableequivalent retrurns ⟨true⟩ on ⟨string⟩ and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifkeyword
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨keyword⟩ is found in the keywords field of the entry currently being processed, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: iflabelalphanametemplatename
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨string⟩ is equal to the current in scope alphabetic label name template name (see § 4.5.6), and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: iflabeldateisdate
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if labeldate is defined and was obtained from date, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: iflistwrapperformatundef
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the formatting directive ⟨format⟩ is undefined, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifmemoirbibintoc
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ or ⟨false⟩, depending on memoir’s \bibintoc and \nobibintoc switches.

macros.name: ifmorenames
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the current name list has been or will be truncated, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifmsentryfield
macros.doc: Returns true if the ⟨entryfield⟩ (i.e. data source field name, regardless of biblatex type of field) is a multiscript field and false otherwise.

macros.name: ifnameformatundef
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the formatting directive ⟨format⟩ is undefined, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifnamewrapperformatundef
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the formatting directive ⟨format⟩ is undefined, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifnatbibmode
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ or ⟨false⟩ depending on the natbib option from § 3.1.1.

macros.name: ifnocite
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the entry was only included in the .bbl via \nocite.

macros.name: ifnumeral
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨string⟩ is an Arabic or Roman numeral, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifnumerals
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨string⟩ is a range or a list of Arabic or Roman numerals, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifpunct
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if preceded by any punctuation mark except for an abbreviation dot, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifpunctmark
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if preceded by the punctuation mark ⟨character⟩, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifsamepage
macros.doc: This command expands to ⟨true⟩ if two instances of a reference are located on the same page or double-page spread, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifsingletitle
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if there is only one work by the labelname name in the bibliography, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifsortingnamekeytemplatename
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨string⟩ is equal to the current in scope sorting name key template name (see § 4.5.6), and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifterm
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if preceded by a terminal punctuation mark, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifterseinits
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ or ⟨false⟩, depending on the state of the terseinits package option (see § 3.1.2.3).

macros.name: ifuniquebaretitle
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if labelname is empty and there is only one work with the title labeltitle and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifuniquenametemplatename
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨string⟩ is equal to the current in scope uniqueness name key template name (see § 4.5.6), and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifuniqueprimaryauthor
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the primary (first) author name of labelname is unique in the bibliography list and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifuniquetitle
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if there is only one work with the title labeltitle and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifuniquework
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if there is only one work by the labelname name with the labeltitle title in the bibliography, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifuseauthor
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the useauthor option is enabled (either globally or for the current entry), and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifuseeditor
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the useeditor option is enabled (either globally or for the current entry), and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifuseprefix
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the useprefix option is enabled (either globally or for the current entry), and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifusetranslator
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the usetranslator option is enabled (either globally or for the current entry), and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifvolcite
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ when located in \volcite or a related citation command (§ 3.9.6), and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifxrefsource
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the entry was inclued in the .bbl due to being referenced more than minxrefs times and false otherwise.

macros.name: indexfield
macros.doc: This command is similar to \printfield except that the ⟨field⟩ is not printed but added to the index using the formatting directive ⟨format⟩, as defined with \DeclareIndexFieldFormat.

macros.name: indexlist
macros.doc: This command is similar to \printlist except that the items in the list are not printed but added to the index using the formatting directive ⟨format⟩, as defined with \DeclareIndexListFormat.

macros.name: indexnames
macros.doc: This command is similar to \printnames except that the items in the list are not printed but added to the index using the formatting directive ⟨format⟩, as defined with \DeclareIndexNameFormat.

macros.name: intciteorder
macros.doc: The \intciteorder element has a special meaning. It requests a sort based on the lexical order internal to the same citation command.

macros.name: intitlepunct
macros.doc: The separator between the word “in” and the following title in entry types such as @article, @inbook, @incollection, etc. The default definition is a colon plus an interword space (e. g., “Article, in: Journal” or “Title, in: Book”).

macros.name: isdot
macros.doc: Turns a previously inserted literal period into an abbreviation dot.

macros.name: labelalphaothers
macros.doc: A string to be appended to the non-numeric portion of the labelalpha field (i. e., the field holding the citation label used by alphabetic citation styles) if the number of authors/editors exceeds the maxalphanames threshold or the author/ editor list was truncated in the bib file with the keyword ‘and others’.

macros.name: labelalphawidth
macros.doc: This length register indicates the width of the widest labelalpha.

macros.name: labelelement
macros.doc: Specifies the elements used to build the label.

macros.name: labelnamepunct
macros.doc: A separator to be printed after the name used for alphabetizing in the bibliography (author or editor, if the author field is undefined) instead of \newunitpunct.

macros.name: labelnumberwidth
macros.doc: This length register indicates the width of the widest labelnumber.

macros.name: letbibmacro
macros.doc: This command defines the macro ⟨alias⟩ to be an alias of the macro ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: localrefcontext
macros.doc: This command is similar to the newrefcontext command except that it sets up the reference context only locally.

macros.name: mancite
macros.doc: Use this command to mark manually inserted citations if you mix automatically generated and manual citations.

macros.name: map
macros.doc: A container for an ordered set of map \steps, optionally restricted to particular entrytypes or data sources.

macros.name: maplangtag
macros.doc: Provides a mapping between the BCP47 language tags used in multiscript entryfield alternate specifications and biblatex/babel/polyglossia language identifiers.

macros.name: maps
macros.doc: Contains an ordered set of \map elements each of which is a logically related set of mapping steps to apply to the data source.

macros.name: midsentence
macros.doc: This command marks the middle of a sentence.

macros.name: mkbibacro
macros.doc: Generic command which typesets an acronym using the small caps variant of the current font, if available, and as-is otherwise.

macros.name: mkbibbold
macros.doc: This is a simple wrapper around the standard \textbf command which incorporates \setpunctfont.

macros.name: mkbibbrackets
macros.doc: A generic command which wraps its argument in square brackets.

macros.name: mkbibcompletename
macros.doc: Formatting hook for the complete name in format order ‘formatorder’.

macros.name: mkbibcompletenamefamily
macros.doc: This command, which takes one argument, is used to format the complete name in family format order.

macros.name: mkbibcompletenamefamilygiven
macros.doc: This command, which takes one argument, is used to format the complete name in family-given format order.

macros.name: mkbibcompletenamegivenfamily
macros.doc: This command, which takes one argument, is used to format the complete name in given-family format order.

macros.name: mkbibdatelong
macros.doc: Takes the names of three field as arguments which correspond to three date components (in the order year/month/day) and uses their values to print the date in the language specific long date format.

macros.name: mkbibdateshort
macros.doc: Similar to \mkbibdatelong but using the language specific short date format.

macros.name: mkbibemph
macros.doc: A generic command which prints its argument as emphasized text.

macros.name: mkbibendnote
macros.doc: Similar in concept to \mkbibfootnote except that it prints its argument as an endnote.

macros.name: mkbibfemord
macros.doc: Similar to \mkbibordinal, but prints a feminine ordinal, if applicable in the respective language.

macros.name: mkbibfootnote
macros.doc: A generic command which prints its argument as a footnote.

macros.name: mkbibitalic
macros.doc: This is a simple wrapper around the standard \textit command which incorporates \setpunctfont.

macros.name: mkbibmascord
macros.doc: Similar to \mkbibordinal, but prints a masculine ordinal, if applicable in the respective language.

macros.name: mkbibmonth
macros.doc: This command takes an integer argument and prints it as a month name.

macros.name: mkbibneutord
macros.doc: Similar to \mkbibordinal, but prints a neuter ordinal, if applicable in the respective language.

macros.name: mkbibordedition
macros.doc: Similar to \mkbibordinal, but intended for use with the term ‘edition’.

macros.name: mkbibordinal
macros.doc: This command, which takes an integer as its argument, prints an ordinal number.

macros.name: mkbibordseries
macros.doc: Similar to \mkbibordinal, but intended for use with the term ‘series’.

macros.name: mkbibparens
macros.doc: A generic command which wraps its argument in parentheses.

macros.name: mkbibquote
macros.doc: A generic command which wraps its argument in quotation marks.

macros.name: mkbibsuperscript
macros.doc: A generic command which prints its argument as superscripted text.

macros.name: mkbibtimezone
macros.doc: Modifies a timezone string passed in as the only argument.

macros.name: mkcomprange
macros.doc: This command, which is intended for use in field formatting directives, will parse its ⟨text⟩ argument for page ranges and compress them.

macros.name: mkdayzeros
macros.doc: This command strips leading zeros from a day or enforces them, depending on the datezeros package option (§ 3.1.2.1).

macros.name: mkfirstpage
macros.doc: This command, which is intended for use in field formatting directives, will parse its ⟨text⟩ argument for page ranges and print the start page of the range only.

macros.name: mkmonthzeros
macros.doc: This command strips leading zeros from a month or enforces them, depending on the datezeros package option (§ 3.1.2.1).

macros.name: mknormrange
macros.doc: This command, which is intended for use in field formatting directives, will parse its ⟨text⟩ argument for page ranges and will normalise them.

macros.name: mknumalph
macros.doc: Takes an integer in the range 1–702 as its argument and converts it to a string as follows: 1=a, ..., 26=z, 27=aa, ..., 702=zz.

macros.name: mkpageprefix
macros.doc: This command is intended for use in field formatting directives which format the page numbers in the ⟨postnote⟩ argument of citation commands and the pages field of bibliography entries. It will parse its ⟨text⟩ argument and prefix it with ‘p.’ or ‘pp.’ by default.

macros.name: mkpagetotal
macros.doc: This command is similar to \mkpageprefix except that it is intended for the pagetotal field of bibliography entries, i. e., it will print “123 pages” rather than “page 123”.

macros.name: mktimezeros
macros.doc: This command strips leading zeros from a number or preserves them, depending on the timezeros package option (§ 3.1.2.1).

macros.name: mkvolcitenote
macros.doc: This macro formats the ⟨volume⟩ and ⟨pages⟩ arguments of \volcite and related commands (§ 3.9.6) when they are passed on to the underlying citation command.

macros.name: mkyearzeros
macros.doc: This command strips leading zeros from a year or enforces them, depending on the datezeros package option (§ 3.1.2.1).

macros.name: multicitedelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed between citations if multiple entry keys are passed to a single citation command.

macros.name: multiciterangedelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed between two citations if they are compressed to a range.

macros.name: multicitesubentrydelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed between subentry citations of the same set.

macros.name: multicitesubentryrangedelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed between two citations of the same set if they are compressed to a range.

macros.name: multilistdelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed between multiple items in a literal list like publisher or location if there are more than two items in the list.

macros.name: multinamedelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed between multiple items in a name list like author or editor if there are more than two names in the list.

macros.name: multipostnotedelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed before the ⟨multipostnote⟩ argument of a citation command.

macros.name: multiprenotedelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed after the ⟨multiprenote⟩ argument of a citation command.

macros.name: namelabeldelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed between the name/title and the label.

macros.name: nametitledelim
macros.doc: The delimiter to be printed between the author/editor and the title.

macros.name: nameyeardelim
macros.doc: The delimiter to be printed between the author/editor and the year.

macros.name: nbhyphen
macros.doc: An explicit, non-breakable hyphen intended for compound words.

macros.name: NewBibliographyString
macros.doc: This command declares new localisation strings, i. e., it initializes a new ⟨key⟩ to be used in the ⟨definitions⟩ of \DefineBibliographyStrings.

macros.name: newbibmacro
macros.doc: Defines a macro to be executed via \usebibmacro later.

macros.name: newblock
macros.doc: Records the end of a block.

macros.name: newblockpunct
macros.doc: The separator inserted between ‘blocks’ in the sense explained in § 4.7.1.

macros.name: newrefcontext
macros.doc: It automatically ends any previous reference context section begun with \newrefcontext (if any) and immediately starts a new one.

macros.name: newrefsection
macros.doc: It automatically ends the previous reference section (if any) and immediately starts a new one.

macros.name: newrefsegment
macros.doc: It automatically ends the previous reference segment (if any) and immediately starts a new one.

macros.name: newunit
macros.doc: Records the end of a unit and puts the default delimiter \newunitpunct in the punctuation buffer.

macros.name: nohyphenation
macros.doc: A generic switch which suppresses hyphenation locally.

macros.name: noinherit
macros.doc: Unconditionally prevents inheritance of the ⟨source⟩ field.

macros.name: noinit
macros.doc: Any number of \noinit commands can be given each of which specifies to remove the ⟨regexp⟩ from the copy of the name which the initials generation system sees.

macros.name: nolabel
macros.doc: Any number of \nolabel commands can be given each of which specifies to remove the ⟨regexp⟩ from the copy of the field which the label generation system sees.

macros.name: nolabelwidthcount
macros.doc: Any number of \nolabelwidthcount commands can be given each of which specifies to ignore the ⟨regexp⟩ when generating fixed-width substrings during label generation.

macros.name: noligature
macros.doc: Disables ligatures at this position and adds some space.

macros.name: nonameyeardelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed between the substitute for the labelname when it does not exist (usually the label or title in standard styles) and the year in author-year citation and bibliography styles.

macros.name: nopp
macros.doc: Similar to \pno but suppresses all prefixes.

macros.name: nopunct
macros.doc: Adds an internal marker which will cause the next punctuation command to print nothing.

macros.name: notecite
macros.doc: These commands print the ⟨prenote⟩ and ⟨postnote⟩ arguments but no citation.

macros.name: Notecite
macros.doc: These commands print the ⟨prenote⟩ and ⟨postnote⟩ arguments but no citation.

macros.name: NumCheckSetup
macros.doc: Use this command to temporarily redefine any commands which interfere with the tests performed by \ifnumeral, \ifnumerals, and \ifpages from § 4.6.2.

macros.name: OnManualCitation
macros.doc: Specifies arbitrary ⟨code⟩ required for a partial reset of the citation style.

macros.name: Parencite
macros.doc: \Parencite is similar to \parencite but capitalizes the name prefix of the first name in the citation if the useprefix option is enabled, provided that there is a name prefix and the citation style prints any name at all.

macros.name: parentext
macros.doc: This command wraps the ⟨text⟩ in context sensitive parentheses.

macros.name: perdatasource
macros.doc: Restricts all \steps in this \map element to entries from the named ⟨datasource⟩.

macros.name: pernottype
macros.doc: Restricts all \steps in this \map element to entries not of the named ⟨entrytype⟩.

macros.name: pertype
macros.doc: Restricts all \steps in this \map element to entries of the named ⟨entrytype⟩.

macros.name: pnfmt
macros.doc: This command formats its argument ⟨text⟩ in the same format as postnote.

macros.name: pno
macros.doc: This command forces a single page prefix in the ⟨postnote⟩ argument to a citation command.

macros.name: pnotecite
macros.doc: Similar to \notecite but the notes are printed in parentheses.

macros.name: Pnotecite
macros.doc: Similar to \notecite but the notes are printed in parentheses.

macros.name: postnotedelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed before the ⟨postnote⟩ argument of a citation command.

macros.name: ppno
macros.doc: Similar to \pno but forces a range prefix.

macros.name: ppspace
macros.doc: The spacing inserted between the pagination suffix and the ⟨text⟩ may be modified by redefining the macro \ppspace.

macros.name: prenotedelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed after the ⟨prenote⟩ argument of a citation command.

macros.name: printbibheading
macros.doc: This command prints a bibliography heading defined with \defbibheading.

macros.name: printbibliography
macros.doc: This command prints the bibliography.

macros.name: printbiblist
macros.doc: This command prints a bibliography list.

macros.name: printdate
macros.doc: This command prints the date of the entry, as specified in the fields date or month/ year.

macros.name: printdateextra
macros.doc: Similar to \printdate but incorporates the extradate field in the date specification.

macros.name: printdelim
macros.doc: Prints a delimiter with name ⟨name⟩, locally establishing a optional ⟨context⟩ first.

macros.name: printfile
macros.doc: This command is similar to \printtext except that the second argument is a file name rather than literal text.

macros.name: printlabeldate
macros.doc: Similar to \printdate but prints the date field determined by \DeclareLabeldate.

macros.name: printlabeldateextra
macros.doc: Similar to \printlabeldate but incorporates the extradate field in the date specification.

macros.name: printtext
macros.doc: This command prints ⟨text⟩, which may be printable text or arbitrary code generating printable text.

macros.name: printtime
macros.doc: This command prints the time range of the entry, as specified in the date field (see § 2.3.8).

macros.name: printunit
macros.doc: The \printunit command is similar to \setunit except that ⟨punctuation⟩ persists in the buffer.

macros.name: providebibmacro
macros.doc: Similar to \newbibmacro but only defines ⟨name⟩ if it is undefined.

macros.name: psq
macros.doc: In the ⟨postnote⟩ argument to a citation command, this command indicates a range of two pages where only the starting page is given.

macros.name: psqq
macros.doc: Similar to \psq but indicates an open-ended page range.

macros.name: pvolcite
macros.doc: Similar to \volcite but based on \parencite.

macros.name: rangelen
macros.doc: Takes the name of a bibfield declared as a range field in the data model and returns the length of the range.

macros.name: regexp
macros.doc: This command can be used with any command accepting a regular expression key to protect a regular expression from being interpreted by TeX so that it is passed through to biber correctly.

macros.name: relateddelim
macros.doc: The generic separator between the data of multiple related entries.

macros.name: relatedpunct
macros.doc: The separator between the relatedtype bibliography localisation string and the data from the first related entry.

macros.name: renewbibmacro
macros.doc: Similar to \newbibmacro but redefines ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: resetpunctfont
macros.doc: This command resets the unit punctuation font defined with \setpunctfont before it takes effect.

macros.name: restorefield
macros.doc: Restores a ⟨field⟩ (optionally a multiscript field of ⟨msform⟩/⟨mslang⟩) from a ⟨macro⟩ defined with \savefield before.

macros.name: restorelistformat
macros.doc: These commands save and restore the formatting directive ⟨format⟩, as defined with \DeclareListFormat.

macros.name: restorename
macros.doc: Restores a hname listi (optionally a multiscript name of ⟨msform⟩/⟨mslang⟩) from a ⟨macro⟩ defined with \savename before.

macros.name: restorenameformat
macros.doc: These commands save and restore the formatting directive ⟨format⟩, as defined with \DeclareNameFormat.

macros.name: revsdnamedelim
macros.doc: An extra delimiter printed after the first name in a name list if the first name is reversed (only in lists with two names).

macros.name: revsdnamepunct
macros.doc: The punctuation to be printed between the given and family name parts when a name is reversed.

macros.name: Rn
macros.doc: Similar to \RN but prints a lowercase Roman numeral.

macros.name: RN
macros.doc: This command prints an integer as an uppercase Roman numeral.

macros.name: savebibmacro
macros.doc: These commands save and restore the macro ⟨name⟩, where ⟨name⟩ is the identifier of a macro defined with \newbibmacro.

macros.name: savecommand
macros.doc: These commands save and restore any ⟨command⟩, which must be a command name starting with a backslash.

macros.name: savefield
macros.doc: Copies an unformatted ⟨field⟩ (optionally a multiscript field of ⟨msform⟩/⟨mslang⟩) to a ⟨macro⟩.

macros.name: savefieldcs
macros.doc: Similar to \savefield, but takes the control sequence name ⟨csname⟩ (without a leading backslash) as an argument, rather than a macro name.

macros.name: savefieldformat
macros.doc: These commands save and restore the formatting directive ⟨format⟩, as defined with \DeclareFieldFormat.

macros.name: savelistcs
macros.doc: Similar to \savelist, but takes the control sequence name ⟨csname⟩ (without a leading backslash) as an argument, rather than a macro name.

macros.name: savelistformat
macros.doc: These commands save and restore the formatting directive ⟨format⟩, as defined with \DeclareListFormat.

macros.name: savelistwrapperformat
macros.doc: These commands save and restore the formatting directive ⟨format⟩, as defined with \DeclareListWrapperFormat.

macros.name: setunit
macros.doc: The \setunit command is similar to \newunit except that it uses ⟨punctuation⟩ instead of \newunitpunct.

macros.name: smartcite
macros.doc: Like \parencite in a footnote and like \footcite in the body.

macros.name: sortalphaothers
macros.doc: Similar to \labelalphaothers but used in the sorting process.

macros.name: sqspace
macros.doc: The spacing inserted between the suffix and the page number may be modified by redefining the macro \sqspace.

macros.name: stdpunctuation
macros.doc: Undoes the settings applied by \uspunctuation, restoring standard punctuation.

macros.name: strfield
macros.doc: Similar to \thefield, except that the field is automatically sanitized such that its value may safely be used in the formation of a control sequence name.

macros.name: stripzeros
macros.doc: This command strips leading zeros from a number.

macros.name: strlist
macros.doc: Similar to \thelist (for a multiscript list, ⟨msform⟩/⟨mslang⟩ may be specified, otherwise, the global or refcontext override values of msform/mslang are used), except that the list internal representation is automatically sanitized such that its value may safely be used in the formation of a control sequence name.

macros.name: strname
macros.doc: Similar to \thename, except that the name internal representation is automatically sanitized such that its value may safely be used in the formation of a control sequence name.

macros.name: subtitlepunct
macros.doc: The separator printed between the fields title and subtitle, booktitle and booksubtitle, as well as maintitle and mainsubtitle.

macros.name: supercite
macros.doc: This command, which is only provided by the numeric styles, prints numeric citations as superscripts without brackets.

macros.name: svolcite
macros.doc: Similar to \volcite but based on \smartcite.

macros.name: textcitedelim
macros.doc: Similar to \multicitedelim, but used by \textcite and related commands (§ 3.9.2).

macros.name: textmainlang
macros.doc: Locally switches from the current language to the main document language to typeset ⟨text⟩.

macros.name: textnohyphenation
macros.doc: Similar to \nohyphenation but restricted to the ⟨text⟩ argument.

macros.name: thefield
macros.doc: Expands to the unformatted ⟨field⟩ (for a multiscript field, ⟨msform⟩/⟨mslang⟩ may be specified, otherwise, the global or refcontext override values of msform/mslang are used).

macros.name: thefirstlistitem
macros.doc: Expands to the unformatted first item in hliteral listi (for a multiscript list, ⟨msform⟩/⟨mslang⟩ may be specified, otherwise, the global or refcontext override values of msform/mslang are used).

macros.name: thelist
macros.doc: Expands to the unformatted hliteral listi (for a multiscript list, ⟨msform⟩/⟨mslang⟩ may be specified, otherwise, the global or refcontext override values of msform/mslang are used).

macros.name: translatortypedelim
macros.doc: The delimiter printed between the translator and the translator string.

macros.name: translit
macros.doc: Specifies that the data field field or all fields in a fieldset ⟨fieldset⟩ declared with \DeclareDatafieldSet (see § 4.5.2) should be transliterated from script ⟨from⟩ to script ⟨to⟩ for sorting purposes.

macros.name: tvolcite
macros.doc: Similar to \volcite but based on \textcite.

macros.name: Tvolcite
macros.doc: Similar to \volcite but based on \textcite.

macros.name: UndeclareBibstringSet
macros.doc: Remove the bibliography string set ⟨setname⟩.

macros.name: UndeclareBibstringSets
macros.doc: Remove all existing bibliography string sets with \UndeclareBibstringSet.

macros.name: UndefineBibliographyExtras
macros.doc: This command is used to restore the original definition of any commands modified with \DefineBibliographyExtras.

macros.name: unspace
macros.doc: Removes preceding whitespace, i. e., removes all skips and penalties from the end of the current horizontal list.

macros.name: usebibmacro
macros.doc: This command executes the macro ⟨name⟩, as defined with \newbibmacro.

macros.name: usedriver
macros.doc: Executes the bibliography driver for an ⟨entrytype⟩.

macros.name: usefield
macros.doc: Executes ⟨command⟩ using the unformatted ⟨field⟩ as its argument (for a multiscript field, ⟨msform⟩/⟨mslang⟩ may be specified, otherwise, the global or refcontext override values of msform/mslang are used).

macros.name: usefirstlistitem
macros.doc: Executes ⟨command⟩ using the unformatted first item of hliteral listi as its argument (for a multiscript list, ⟨msform⟩/⟨mslang⟩ may be specified, otherwise, the global or refcontext override values of msform/mslang are used).

macros.name: uspunctuation
macros.doc: A shorthand using the lower-level commands \DeclareQuotePunctuation and \DeclarePunctuationPairs to activate ‘American-style’ punctuation.

macros.name: Volcite
macros.doc: These commands are similar to \cite and \Cite but intended for references to multi-volume works which are cited by volume and page number.
